MEMO TO THE BOARD OF [AUTHORITY]

Re: Proposed taxable revenue bond and PILOT for [COMPANY]'s [PROJECT] in [COUNTY]

Recommendation: staff recommends approval, subject to final documents.

Financing. The Authority would issue $12,000,000 in taxable revenue bonds, 20-year term, 4.50% fixed. Level monthly payments are about $75,918, or $911,015 per year. Total interest over the term is about $6.22 million. Projected net operating income of $1,500,000 gives debt service coverage of about 1.65x. Bond par is 44.4% of the $27,000,000 total investment ($18,000,000 building, $9,000,000 equipment).

PILOT. Only the real property is taxed; equipment is excluded. At 40% assessment and 28.5 mills, full annual tax is $205,200. Years 1-5 are fully abated, the abatement then steps down 10 points per year, and full taxes apply in year 15. In year 7 the company pays $41,040. Over 15 years, abated taxes total $1,949,400 (present value about $1,496,856 at 5.0%), and the company pays $1,128,600.

Benefits. 150 full-time jobs at $52,000 average wage create $7,800,000 in annual payroll. The abatement costs about $12,996 per job over 15 years.

Note: figures were computed by hand and are rounded; staff will confirm before closing.
